title: Dictation into notes, and Lunna at the foot of them

screens.title: A task's notes
screens.why: Tempo's dock comes to the notes: Lunna's bar, and a mic where the + was.

pins.label: Lunna's bar
pins.text: Tempo's bar as it is, 'Pergunte à Lunna…'. Tapped, it opens the conversation, which is told about this task.

pins.label: Small mic asks
pins.text: Inside the bar, beside the crescent: talks to Lunna, exactly as on Tempo (press or hold).

pins.label: Big mic writes
pins.text: The AppFab in the +'s place, Phosphor microphone: plain speech to text into the notes, never to Lunna. Tap to start, tap stop.

pins.label: Typing unchanged
pins.text: The notes are still a plain field. While the keyboard is up the dock steps aside.

screens.title: Dictating
screens.why: Plain speech to text, streamed straight into the note as it is heard.

pins.label: New paragraph
pins.text: Each recording is a paragraph of its own, after a blank line at the end of the notes.

pins.label: Live words
pins.text: Words the recognizer can still revise are ink3, settled ones ink. Saved as they settle (same 800 ms debounce as typing).

pins.label: Same recorder
pins.text: Lunna's VoiceBar: trash, breathing dot, timer, live wave. Trash takes back only this paragraph.

pins.label: Stop keeps
pins.text: Stop: the words stay, the dock comes back. No 1-minute limit: it runs until stopped.

screens.title: Asking Lunna by voice
screens.why: The small mic is Tempo's recorder: words rise in a card, not into the note.

pins.label: Words for Lunna
pins.text: The question rises above the bar, as on Tempo; tap it to open the conversation. The note is untouched.

pins.label: Stop asks
pins.text: Stop opens the conversation with the words in the field, selected (one minute at most, as on Tempo).

screens.title: A project's notes
screens.why: The same dock on Notas; Tarefas keeps Lunna's bar and the +.

pins.label: About the project
pins.text: The conversation knows this project, its notes and its tasks.

pins.label: Notas only
pins.text: Before, nothing floated over the notes. Now Notas has the mic; Tarefas keeps the + that writes a task.

screens.title: A second take
screens.why: Speak again later: a new paragraph under the last one.

pins.label: Earlier take
pins.text: An earlier dictation is ordinary text now, edited like anything typed.

pins.label: Follows the end
pins.text: The new paragraph; the page scrolls to keep the words in sight as they arrive.
